correctness.rationale: An undirected labeled path induces strict order betweenness modulo reversal; its edges can be recovered as endpoint pairs with no vertex in between. Endpoints of a query may be reversed without effect. Independent exhaustive enumeration of the local truth tables and exact version-space recursion confirmed (VC,Ldim)=(0,0),(0,0),(1,1),(2,3),(4,5). In particular all 220 three-query supports at size four and all 142506 five-query supports at size five failed to shatter; heredity excludes all larger supports. For an arbitrary number of blocks with fixed supports, the VC lower and upper bounds are exactly the union and projection of shattered query sets. For the online upper bound any root of a positive-depth shattered subtree must have two nonempty branches and acts in exactly one local factor of the current product. At least one branch decreases that local factor's Littlestone dimension by at least one by the maximum-minimum splitting rule, while every other factor stays fixed. This bounds depth by the sum. Concatenating local trees attains the sum. Constant cross-block queries cannot assist either kind of shattering.
residual_risks: Local enumeration covers sizes 1–5 only. Arbitrarily many blocks are handled by a product proof, not by extrapolating the finite enumeration. No claim for variable supports or larger block sizes is inferred.
